fusions.name: Bound to the Accused
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto the target and strike it with the rod, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Nipping Distraction
fusions.desc: Flicks a speck at the first enemy in line that deals 4 damage, with a 25% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold Court
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. An escort of fleas fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every second.

fusions.name: Distance Is No Excuse
fusions.desc: Once you have covered enough ground, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
